assessments.reasoning: Printed p. 45 defines one named slot per instance for each available variable name. Printed p. 61 resolves cashOnHand to the receiving DeductibleHistory instance even though its method comes from FinancialHistory. The inherited spend method likewise uses the receiver’s cash and expenditure state.

challenge.method: Compare the defining class with the actual subclass receiver and check indexed access on printed p. 47.
challenge.results: A FinancialHistory method receives a DeductibleHistory instance, and its direct names select slots of that object. Printed p. 47 describes separate selectors for indexed storage, outside the scope of this named-variable proposition.

limitations: Named direct access in the published example. Indexed storage, reflection, and shared variables have separate scopes.
